assertion.en: Cardiac muscle can contract continuously without fatigue.

reason.en: Cardiac muscle cells have a high number of mitochondria and an abundant blood supply.

a.en: Correct. Both are true. Mitochondria release energy in a cell, and a rich blood supply brings oxygen and food, so heart muscle has the energy to keep working without tiring.

b.en: Both are true, but the reason does explain the assertion: many mitochondria and plenty of blood give heart muscle a steady supply of energy, which lets it work without fatigue.

c.en: The reason is true: heart muscle cells have many mitochondria and a rich blood supply.

d.en: The assertion is true: cardiac muscle works rhythmically throughout life without fatigue.

explanation.en: Cardiac muscle beats throughout life without fatigue, so the assertion is true. Its cells have many mitochondria, which release energy, and a rich blood supply, which brings oxygen and food. A steady supply of energy is a large part of why heart muscle does not tire, so the reason explains the assertion.
